battery/PDB tap -> Uno Q (no buck; 20 AWG V+/GND; Uno Q accepts the 3S rail via its own regulator)
Uno Q USB-C -> motor controller / USB bus-servo adapter -> servo ID 2 bus head (L0 yaw, data)
Uno Q I2C -> GY-521 MPU glued on chassis_bottom (behind phys. leg 1; 28 AWG 3V3/GND/SCL/SDA -- 3V3)
